title.value: TANGO: a placebo-controlled randomized phase 2 study of efficacy and safety of the anti-tau monoclonal antibody gosuranemab in early Alzheimer’s disease
title.quote: TANGO: a placebo-controlled randomized phase 2 study of efficacy and safety of the anti-tau monoclonal antibody gosuranemab in early Alzheimer’s disease

design.value: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group and multiple-dose long-term trial
design.quote: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group and multiple-dose long-term trial

population.value: patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) due to AD and those with mild AD dementia
population.quote: patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) due to AD and those with mild AD dementia

biomarker_confirmation.value: evidence of amyloid pathology, confirmed by amyloid PET (visual read) or CSF testing
biomarker_confirmation.quote: evidence of amyloid pathology, confirmed by amyloid PET (visual read) or CSF testing

intervention.value: low-dose (125 mg once every 4 weeks (q4w), n = 58; 375 mg q12w, n = 58), intermediate-dose (600 mg q4w, n = 106) or high-dose (2,000 mg q4w, n = 214) gosuranemab
intervention.quote: low-dose (125 mg once every 4 weeks (q4w), n = 58; 375 mg q12w, n = 58), intermediate-dose (600 mg q4w, n = 106) or high-dose (2,000 mg q4w, n = 214) gosuranemab

outcomes.name: incidence of AEs and SAEs
outcomes.quote: For the placebo-controlled period of this study, the primary endpoint was the incidence of AEs and SAEs.
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: For the placebo-controlled period of this study, the primary endpoint was the incidence of AEs and SAEs.

outcomes.name: change in the CDR-SB score from baseline over time at week 78
outcomes.quote: The secondary endpoints were (1) the change in the CDR-SB score from baseline over time at week 78
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: The secondary endpoints were (1) the change in the CDR-SB score from baseline over time at week 78

outcomes.name: incidence of anti-gosuranemab serum antibody responses over time up to week 90
outcomes.quote: The secondary endpoints were [...] (2) the incidence of anti-gosuranemab serum antibody responses over time up to week 90.
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: The secondary endpoints were [...] (2) the incidence of anti-gosuranemab serum antibody responses over time up to week 90.

outcomes.name: change from baseline in the 13-item Alzheimer’s Disease Assessment Scale–Cognitive Subscale (ADAS-Cog13) score at week 78
outcomes.quote: In one exploratory endpoint, the change from baseline in the 13-item Alzheimer’s Disease Assessment Scale–Cognitive Subscale (ADAS-Cog13) score at week 78, patients in the high-dose gosuranemab group performed statistically significantly worse than those in the placebo group
outcomes.location: Results, Exploratory endpoints: other key efficacy outcomes (cognitive and functional analyses)
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: Key exploratory endpoints included (1) the change from baseline at week 78 in the ADAS-Cog13, MMSE, ADCS-ADL and FAQ scores

primary_endpoint_status.quote: Gosuranemab had an acceptable safety profile and was generally well tolerated
primary_endpoint_status.explanation: The primary objective of assessing safety and tolerability was met, with similar incidence of adverse events across treatment and placebo groups.

deaths.value: one death occurred in the placebo group (0.5%) and two deaths occurred across all gosuranemab groups (0.5%)
deaths.quote: During the placebo-controlled period, one death occurred in the placebo group (0.5%) and two deaths occurred across all gosuranemab groups (0.5%).
deaths.location: Results, Primary endpoint results for gosuranemab safety and tolerability

discontinuations.value: 5.1% in the placebo group and 3.2% in the combined gosuranemab groups
discontinuations.quote: Rates of treatment discontinuation due to AEs were low overall and comparable between the placebo (5.1%) and combined gosuranemab (3.2%) groups.
discontinuations.location: Results, Primary endpoint results for gosuranemab safety and tolerability

serious_adverse_events.value: placebo, 12.1%; low dose, 10.3%; intermediate dose, 12.3%; high dose, 11.7%
serious_adverse_events.quote: incidence of serious adverse events: placebo, 12.1%; low dose, 10.3%; intermediate dose, 12.3%; high dose, 11.7%

limitations: This study was affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
Limited data were collected during the LTE period due to the early termination of the study.

multiplicity.approach: No adjustments were made for multiple comparisons.
multiplicity.quote: No adjustments were made for multiple comparisons.
